items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I remember when Wally Bishop came through with Earl Hines.

ctx.x: ...I'm sure in your travels you must have come in contact with Wally Bishop?

Of course, I mean, who else but Wally Bishop, until he had the accident with Earl Hines' band. I remember when Wally Bishop came through with Earl Hines. They had the Mills Brothers and they had the Palmer Brothers and they came through Kansas City. But also you must remember I knew Bishop before then. Then when they had that terrible accident that Cecil Irwin lost his life, through Iowa.
